data.content:
I fixed the TypeScript/cache noise at the source: the nested VitePress cache files under `docs/docs/.vitepress/cache/deps/` were actually tracked, so ignores couldn’t hide them from workspace tooling. I deleted those generated cache files and updated [.gitignore](.gitignore) so regenerated nested cache/temp output stays ignored.

I also added explicit cache exclusions to [docs/tsconfig.json](docs/tsconfig.json). Validation: `git check-ignore --no-index` now matches the nested cache/temp paths, `tsc --listFilesOnly` shows no VitePress cache files, VS Code reports no diagnostics on the touched configs, and `node scripts/quality/fallow-health-gate.ts` passes.

One caveat: `vp exec tsc -p docs/tsconfig.json --noEmit` still crashes inside the installed TypeScript 5.6.1-rc compiler with `Debug Failure. False expression...`, but the stack has no cache path and remains after the cache removal, so that looks like a separate existing compiler issue.
